# CONSTITUTION — the INV-GOLDEN guard (EARS + STE)

- **INV-GOLDEN-01 — a human is the sole author of an approved golden.** An agent shall not
  create, edit, rename, or delete a file whose name contains the marker; the guard shall enforce
  this rule fail-closed; the guard shall allow a read; the guard shall block every writing path
  the guard can recognise.
